Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
Upper Text: [Your Turn] When one of your Digimon digivolves into [Angewomon] or [LadyDevimon], if you have 1 or fewer Digimon in play, by suspending this Tamer, you may play 1 [Angewomon] or [LadyDevimon] with a different name than the Digimon you digivolved into from your hand without paying the cost.
